messages:
jamie: heads-up: us-west/gpu-pool-7 spiking >92% last 3m, ingress qlen jumped to 470, tail p95->1.8s. seeing egress errors to S3 causing retries :warning:
ops-bot: ALERT gpu-pool-7 saturation (92%) | qlen 470 | rps 12k | affected-tenants: 22 | https://monitoring/redwood/gpu-pool-7
sofia: can we spill to us-east? cross-region adds egress cost and ~120ms p99. also watch data-residency for corp tenants — maybe only spill best-effort / free tier.
lee: quick win: enable model-fallback to quantized-lite v2 for non-enterprise tiers. saves ~30% GPU per request. quality hit ~5-8% on our eval set.
mira: agreed. propose tiered admission + fallback config idea:
```
admission:
  thresholds:
    enterprise: 0.9
    pro: 0.75
    free: 0.5
  fallback:
    pro: quant-v2
    free: quant-v2-lite
  spillover:
    region_order: [us-west, us-east, eu-west]
    max_egress_per_min: 200MB
```
jamie: also seeing intermittent packet drops on us-west-az3 NICs — opening infra incident. if we spill, prefer us-west-az2 first to keep intra-region traffic.
sofia: cost sanity check: cross-region egress at 100MB/s sustained -> est ~$14k/day. set a hard egress cap and degrade to queued rejects once hit.
lee: runtime note: when fallback triggers, invalidate KV cache entries or we'll get huge cache-miss storm. patch ready: `runtime/cache: invalidate_on_fallback=true`.
mira: rollout plan: enable fallback for 10% traffic for free/pro for 15m canary. command to flip flag:
```
curl -X POST 'https://console/flags' -d '{"flag":"tiered-fallback","pct":10,"target":"non-enterprise"}'
```
monitor p99, error-rate, cost.
jamie: operational tweak: when qlen > 400, set admission_mode=probabilistic with p=0.6 for free tier (probabilistic drop). reduces overload without full rejection.
ops-bot: NOTE: created incident INC-2026-437 for us-west-az3 NIC flakiness. https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-437
sofia: any objections to canary now?
lee: no objections. flipping flag and pushing runtime patch. will post logs/links.
lee: patch pushed, flag set to 10%. canary started. dashboard: https://dashboards/rt/eviction-canary
mira: observing metrics: free-tier p99 lowered 1.1s->0.6s, error-rate flat, small egress uptick. looks promising.
jamie: if stable at 15m, scale to 50% then full for non-enterprise. keep enterprise pinned to high-threshold.
sofia: tagging note for billing: add cost tag `spillover-fallback` to cross-region egress so we can apportion to this feature :money_with_wings:
lee: will follow up with a short runbook op note on fallback behavior and cache invalidation steps.
jamie: thanks all — keeping this thread pinned until incident cleared and canary fully evaluated.
